newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TENDER SOON IN AGRICULTURAL BANK SALE.
newsitem.headline: TENDER SOON IN AGRICULTURAL BANK SALE.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry expects to announce a tender for its financial adviser in the Agricultural Bank privatisation soon and to make the selection in August, the finance minister said.

"Concerning the Agricultural Bank, we will very soon announce the tender for slection of the financial adviser and according schedule, the financial adviser should be selected in August," Finance Minister Algirdas Shemeta told Reuters.
Shemeta said the preparation for the privatisation of the Agricultural Bank would start in November.
"Actual privatisation should take place in the beginning of 1998," Shemeta said.
Shemeta told Reuters on Wednesday that the plan was to launch a tender for Lithuanian State Commercial Bank in the last ten days of May, with the actual tender process to come in June.
The minister said the results of the State Commercial Bank privatisation were expected in the beginning of July.

Shemeta said the plan was to hold off on privatising the "Concerning Savings Bank, we are not planning to propose this bank for privatisation yet," Shemeta said. "It depends on how successful the privatisation of the other banks will be."
